description: Live sports board: upcoming and in-play games with main-market prices (moneyline, spread, total) and the best posted price per selection across connected books. Decision support; never a guarantee and never a wager. The default board may reserve/spend odds-refresh units under the app rules; retries deduplicate only within the existing 60-second usage bucket. Set view: app for the current app Live board and its provider, filters and cursor.

category.description: Current app games board only; current event prices are a separate app read.

leagues.description: League labels to filter by, e.g. ['MLB','NFL']. Omit for all leagues.

limit.description: Legacy main-market board: max 50. Current app games view: max 20.

view.description: Use the current app Live board; omit for the legacy main-market board.

name: get_todays_board
title: Today's board (live odds)
